edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against admin inside _setPendingImplementation to gate the privileged state change.
msg.sender must equal pendingWanFarmImplementation for the implementation takeover to succeed.
msg.sender is compared against admin before pendingAdmin can be updated.
msg.sender must equal pendingAdmin for the admin transfer to complete.
msg.data forwarded by the fallback is caller controlled and passed to the delegatecall.
The fallback performs the delegatecall to the implementation with caller-supplied calldata.
wanFarmImplementation is the delegatecall target stored in the proxy contract.
msg.sender determines the user record credited and the recipient of reward and LP transfers in deposit.
msg.sender determines the user record, pending reward payout and LP transfer recipient in withdraw.
emergencyWithdraw is restricted by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender to admin.
quitwanWan is onlyOwner and therefore depends on the msg.sender check against admin.
quitExtFarm is onlyOwner and gated by the msg.sender==admin check.
enableDoubleFarming is onlyOwner and gated by the msg.sender==admin check.
setDoubleFarming is onlyOwner and gated by the msg.sender==admin check.
distributeFinalExtReward is onlyOwner and gated by the msg.sender==admin check.
_become requires msg.sender to equal uniFarm.admin() before accepting the implementation.
deposit calls depositLPToSuShiChef after accounting, where external farm calls and token transfers occur.
withdraw calls withDrawLPFromSuShi before final accounting, triggering external farm interaction.
depositLPToSuShiChef invokes the external sushi farm deposit, handing control to an untrusted contract before state settlement.
withDrawLPFromSuShi invokes the external sushi farm withdraw before user debt is settled, enabling reentrancy.
deposit transfers accumulated wanWan rewards to msg.sender via the ERC20 transfer.
withdraw transfers accumulated wanWan rewards to msg.sender via the ERC20 transfer.
depositLPToSuShiChef transfers sushi rewards to msg.sender while external farm state is still being updated.
withDrawLPFromSuShi transfers sushi rewards to msg.sender during settlement of external farm debt.
deposit pulls LP tokens from msg.sender using safeTransferFrom.
withdraw returns LP tokens to msg.sender using safeTransfer.
updatePool reads and writes the poolInfo entry to refresh reward accumulation.
deposit reads and updates the caller's userInfo record.
withdraw reads and updates the caller's userInfo record.
depositLPToSuShiChef adjusts the caller's extRewardDebt in userInfo.
withDrawLPFromSuShi adjusts the caller's extRewardDebt in userInfo.
quitExtFarm transfers the computed surplus sushi balance to the owner-supplied recipient.
quitwanWan forwards the remaining balance to the safe transfer helper.
deposit calls updatePool before crediting the user to refresh reward indices.
withdraw calls updatePool before computing pending rewards.
The wanWan token state variable is the ERC20 used directly by the reward transfer calls.
_pid parameter selects the poolInfo entry used throughout deposit.
_amount parameter controls how many LP tokens are pulled and credited in deposit.
_pid parameter selects the poolInfo and userInfo entries used in withdraw.
_amount parameter controls how many LP tokens are burned and returned in withdraw.
The pending local variable is the computed reward amount passed to wanWan.transfer.
The user local pointer provides extRewardDebt and amount used to compute the sushi transfer.
The pool local pointer supplies extFarmInfo and currentSupply used during sushi farm settlement.
newPendingImplementation parameter is stored into pendingWanFarmImplementation.
newPendingAdmin parameter is stored into pendingAdmin.
_to parameter is the validated recipient of the sweeps in quitwanWan.
extFarmAddr parameter selects the external farm whose unclaimed rewards are excluded from the sweep.

normalization_plan.reason: _pid is a caller-supplied pool selector consumed only by deposit/withdraw and should be folded into the corresponding core function node.
_amount is a caller-supplied value fully determined by the deposit call and carries no independent semantic identity.
_to is a parameter of quitwanWan and only meaningful within that privileged function.
extFarmAddr is a parameter of quitExtFarm used only to locate the external farm for the sweep.
pending is a temporary computed reward value that directly feeds the wanWan.transfer unsafe operation.
user is a local storage pointer to the caller UserInfo used to compute pending rewards and debts inside withdraw.
pool is a local storage pointer to PoolInfo used to update external farm reward accounting in depositLPToSuShiChef.
newPendingImplementation is the sole input written by the privileged implementation-transfer function.
newPendingAdmin is the sole input written by the privileged admin-transfer function.
